opening_message: Please change booking BK-183 to flight UA183SFO, and keep the ground plans coherent with the new destination. My user ID is user_004.

user_simulator.personality: Busy traveler who wants the trip kept coherent, not just the flight changed.
user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are switching the trip destination from Los Angeles to San Francisco and expect related lodging to be fixed too.
known_info: Booking BK-183 should move to San Francisco flight UA183SFO.
Keep the hotel dates but make sure the hotel matches the new destination.
task_rules: Open by asking to change BK-183 to UA183SFO and keep the ground plans coherent. The agent already has your opening message.
If the agent changes only the flight and ignores the existing LAX hotel, ask whether the hotel still matches the new destination.
Approve canceling the LAX hotel and booking a comparable SFO hotel for the same dates.
End only after the flight is changed and the hotel has been moved from LAX to SFO; then use [TASK_DONE].

task_summary: User changes booking BK-183 from arriving at LAX to arriving at SFO, and asks the agent to keep ground plans coherent. Existing hotel HR-183 is in LAX for the old arrival city. Correct cascade: change the flight to UA183SFO, cancel the old LAX hotel, and book HOTEL-SFO-183 for the same hotel dates. The cascading hotel fix is the point of the task.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must change BK-183 to flight UA183SFO while preserving booking preferences.
Agent must recognize the existing LAX hotel no longer matches the changed SFO trip, cancel HR-183, and book HOTEL-SFO-183 for the same dates.
